figurative_meaning_bn: অপরিবর্তিত; একই ব্যাপার; কিছু যায় আসে না
figurative_meaning_en: unchanged; the same thing; it doesn't matter
similar_in_english: six of one and half a dozen of the other
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি যাই করো না কেন, অল দা সেম।
দুটো অপশনই অল দা সেম, কোনোটাই ভালো নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: It doesn't matter what you do, it's all the same.
Both options are all the same, neither is good.
history: This idiom is a phonetic borrowing from English 'all the same' into Bengali, commonly used in urban, English-influenced speech.
note: Primarily used in modern, cosmopolitan Bengali contexts.
